freeze_timing: Before any C39 quality result or C13 paired confirmation outcome; correction of a discovered complete-parent implementation mismatch.

comparisons.P01: Actual stock baseline with the already tested formate compatibility repair; existing reference-masked C41 core output.
comparisons.P16: P01 followed by the exact frozen production measured-reference overlay, with validation-only reference exclusions.
comparisons.cpu_and_gpu: The same frozen new heads applied to P16, matching the production order.
comparisons.P14: Original frozen P14 control on the same P01 core and complete query panel; do not add a new overlay to this historical negative control.

C39_reference_exclusion: For the additional measured-reference library, exclude official query identities, same formulas, same nonempty Murcko scaffolds, Morgan2 Tanimoto >= 0.70 to any frozen C39 query, unparseable identities, and query-acquisition signature aliases. Preserve retained metadata/peak alignment and original order. Do not change production reference data.

admission_before_C13.complete_cpu_and_gpu_vs_P01: Each must have strictly positive development192 exact MRR delta and nonnegative exact deltas for every source and actual query mode.
admission_before_C13.incremental_cpu_and_gpu_vs_P16: Each must separately pass the same development/source/query-mode criteria; an old parent overlay cannot qualify a harmful new head.
admission_before_C13.complete_changes_relative_to_P01: Must exactly equal the frozen P16 overlay followed by the frozen head. P16 can promote rank1 or insert a reference candidate by its existing policy. Report every recovered/displaced truth and every rank1/membership change; do not incorrectly assert zero for the full composite.

C13.prerequisite: Both full candidates and both incremental heads pass all C39 gates and full production-source/artifact checks.
C13.reference_exclusion: Use the complete original C13 candidate-source identity inventory for official-identity exclusion, conservatively exclude unparseable identities and query-input spectral aliases, without opening the reserved per-query labels. Near-chemistry exposure remains reported, as in the original C13 protocol.
C13.complete_candidate_vs_P01: Each exact point delta must be nonnegative for all120, positive60 and negative60.
C13.incremental_head_vs_P16: Each exact point delta must be nonnegative for all120 and positive60; all60 negative queries retain P16 exactly.
C13.instrument_limitation: C13 is single-acquisition FT/HCD source stress; it is not a replacement for target timsTOF evidence.

qualification_tier: Exploratory fixed pair, not statistical promotion or established leaderboard calibration. Only actual public scores establish improvement.
